g.text: Measured Pareto frontiers on Apple M4 Pro · 8 Rayon threads · zero knowledge enabled

g.text: Each panel uses one measurement cohort and its own axes.

g.text: Points use three timings and three peak RSS measurements per

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #485b70

g.text: configuration. Straight segments join nondominated medians.
